first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A foreground person with short brown hair, wearing a dark blue-gray top, brown trousers, and a brown shoulder strap, and holding a gun in the right hand.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: The red rectangular shop stall on the right side of the passageway, with a gray horizontally ridged roller shutter and a large red pattern.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: The gray-brown paving connecting the foreground to the steps, with irregular dark wet patches and scattered debris.

entities.name: distant curved building
entities.identification: The light-colored multistory building at the upper right, with curved corner balconies and green edging.

entities.name: group of people lying in front of the steps
entities.identification: The group of people lying on the near side of the wooden-slat partition, on the near side of the blue-and-white steps, and beside the shop stall with a red roller shutter, excluding Person A.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: The orange wooden display table in front of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with a rectangular tabletop and a front made of horizontal slats.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: The wide multilevel steps connecting the passageway to the upper market, with small light-blue and white tiles arranged on the risers.

entities.name: wooden-slat partition
entities.identification: The tall rectangular partition on the left side of the passageway, composed of yellow-brown horizontal slats and vertical frame edges.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: The market building above the blue-and-white steps, with a wide eave, light-colored square columns, and a dark counter.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The short silver-gray handgun held in Person A's right hand, distinct from the interface icon at the lower left and other firearms on the ground.

entities.name: sky between the buildings
entities.identification: The pale-blue sky and white clouds visible between the rooftops.

entities.name: surrounding market buildings
entities.identification: The group of buildings with visible blue-gray or yellow-brown walls in the background, excluding the separately listed shop stall, market hall, and curved building.

entities.name: light-colored bag-shaped object
entities.identification: The bulging beige-gray bag-shaped goods on the lower level of the stall rack on the left.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: The group of yellow and brown bottles and jars and blue-green buckets and basins in the market, with subsets defined by their locations.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: The group of fruits on the orange-fruit table with yellow-green oval fruit bodies and gray-green crowns of pointed leaves.

entities.name: stacked goods
entities.identification: The source ID covers the relatively thick box-shaped stacks on the small light-green table and the bundled flat stacks on the orange-fruit table.

entities.name: small light-green table
entities.identification: The narrow, elongated light-green wooden table at the lower right of the opening image, with a rectangular tabletop, slender legs, and a low crossbar.

entities.name: scattered papers on the ground
entities.identification: The scattered thin sheet-like debris on the passageway, ranging from light gray and beige-gray to gray-brown.

entities.name: gray smoke near the market hall
entities.identification: The gray-brown translucent clouds of smoke near and above the eave of the raised market hall.
